name: Carrickfergus Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Carrickfergus Baptist Church. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required.

name: Mid and East Antrim Council Allotments
short_description: Council allotment sites in Carrickfergus area
description: Mid and East Antrim Council manages sites including Brownsbay and Carrickfergus. Plots from £20/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access.

name: Carrickfergus Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden in Shaftesbury Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Traditional Irish apple varieties grown.
